name: Weapons
overview: Scripture presents weapons within the context of both human conflict and divine protection. While David acknowledges God as the source of strength for warfare (Psalms 144:1), Isaiah reveals God's ultimate plan for peace when nations will transform swords into plowshares (Isaiah 2:4). Jesus teaches restraint, warning against retaliation and the destructive cycle of violence (Matthew 5:38; 26:52), emphasizing that reliance on weapons leads to ruin. God's promise in Isaiah 54:17 assures believers that no weapon formed against them will succeed, highlighting the spiritual security found in Him even amid physical threats.
